predictions.title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One British Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Mercedes has dominated early 2026 F1 with 7 poles in 7 races and 6 victories, led by Kimi Antonelli (5 consecutive wins before a late mechanical DNF from P2 in Barcelona) and George Russell (1 win, 3 poles). At Silverstone, home heroes Hamilton (9x British GP winner, fresh off winning Barcelona after back-to-back P2s), Russell, and defending 2025 Silverstone winner Norris are Antonelli's primary threats.

predictions.title: Who will win the 2026 MotoGP German Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Marc Marquez has won 11 times across classes at anti-clockwise Sachsenring and enters in surging form after back-to-back 2026 MotoGP wins in Hungary and Brno on the factory Ducati GP26. Aprilia RS-GP26 title leaders Marco Bezzecchi (4 GP wins in 2026, returning from his 1-race Brno ban) and 2023 Sachsenring winner Jorge Martin, plus 2024 Sachsenring winner Francesco Bagnaia and Pedro Acosta, lead the challengers.

predictions.title: Who will win stage 11 of the 2026 Tour de France?
predictions.reasoning: Stage 11 (Vichy to Nevers, 161.3 km, ProfileScore 12) is a pan-flat transition stage into wide straight avenues in Nevers (~90% bunch sprint probability), and 2025 green jersey winner Jonathan Milan as well as Wout van Aert are absent from the 2026 Tour de France startlist. Tim Merlier (5 sprint wins in 11 race days returning in June), Jasper Philipsen (backed by Mathieu van der Poel and Kaden Groves), and Olav Kooij form a clear top sprint tier ahead of Biniam Girmay and Lidl-Trek leader Mads Pedersen.

predictions.title: Which driver will rank second in the Formula One drivers' championship immediately after the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Entering Round 8 (Austria), Kimi Antonelli leads with 156 points ahead of Lewis Hamilton (115) and George Russell (106), while Leclerc (75) and Norris (73) sit 40+ points behind second place with only three race weekends (Austria, Great Britain Sprint+GP, Belgium) before resolution. Monte Carlo simulation over those 83 maximum available points shows Hamilton (~50%, aided by his 9-point buffer and high reliability) and Russell (~43%, aided by Mercedes' faster car) dominate P2 outcomes, with a ~4% tail where Antonelli slips to second.

predictions.title: Which driver will be fastest in final practice for the 2026 Formula One Hungarian Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Mercedes has taken all 7 poles in 2026 and split most FP3 benchmarks between Kimi Antonelli (fastest in Japan and Monaco FP3) and George Russell (fastest in Barcelona FP3), though single-session practice carries added traffic and run-plan variance. Charles Leclerc (top-3 in Japan, Monaco, and Barcelona FP3) and McLaren duo Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri (P2 in Barcelona FP3, historically strong at high-downforce Hungaroring) round out the top soft-tyre FP3 contenders.

predictions.title: Which circuit will Formula One announce as the replacement venue for the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: The July 25, 2026 resolution date (far ahead of the December 31 deadline) confirms F1 announces a replacement venue during the Hungarian GP weekend before summer break. Following F1's April 24 five-year agreement with Istanbul Park for 2027-2031, FIA President Mohammed Ben Sulayem explicitly stated on May 7 that Istanbul Park could step in for 2026 pending a summer decision and FIA homologation—matching the criteria's regulatory-approval clause—ahead of primary European stand-ins Algarve International Circuit (Portimao) and Imola.

predictions.title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Hungarian Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Track position is decisive at tight Hungaroring, heavily favoring Mercedes' 100% 2026 pole-winning package led by Kimi Antonelli (who won Monaco from pole) and George Russell. Eight-time Hungarian GP winner Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari teammate Charles Leclerc, and McLaren's Lando Norris are the strongest threats on high-downforce race pace and strategy.

predictions.title: Who will win the main MotoGP race at the 2026 British Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Unlike tight Sachsenring, fast and flowing Silverstone historically favors the Aprilia RS-GP26—ridden by 2026 championship leader Marco Bezzecchi (4 GP wins including fast Mugello) and Jorge Martin—creating a close battle with resurgent Ducati Lenovo star Marc Marquez. Past Silverstone winner Francesco Bagnaia and Catalunya winner Fabio Di Giannantonio (3rd in the 2026 standings) also hold strong podium/win equity.

predictions.title: Which driver will take pole position for the inaugural Freedom 250 Grand Prix in Washington, DC?
predictions.reasoning: With Colton Herta out of IndyCar in 2026 as Cadillac F1 test driver, Alex Palou has dominated 2026 qualifying with 5 poles in the first 10 rounds—including the similarly compact Detroit street circuit—plus front-row/top-3 qualifying at Arlington and Long Beach. Street-course qualifying standouts Kyle Kirkwood (Andretti #1), Scott McLaughlin (2026 St. Pete pole, Detroit P3), Felix Rosenqvist (2026 Long Beach pole), and Pato O'Ward (Long Beach P2, Arlington P3) lead a deep Firestone Fast Six field.

predictions.title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Dutch Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Zandvoort's narrow, high-downforce layout rewards qualifying supremacy, keeping Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli and George Russell as clear favorites, moderated slightly by post-summer upgrade uncertainty. Lewis Hamilton, 2024 Zandvoort winner Lando Norris, and three-time Dutch GP winner Max Verstappen (in Zandvoort's final scheduled F1 appearance) round out the top five.

predictions.title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Italian Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Monza's high-speed power demands suit the benchmark 2026 Mercedes power unit of Italian championship leader Kimi Antonelli, George Russell, and McLaren's Lando Norris. Ferrari consistently brings bespoke low-drag upgrades for its home race, giving five-time Monza winner Lewis Hamilton and two-time Monza winner Charles Leclerc (2019, 2024) elevated win probabilities.

predictions.title: Which driver will win the 2026 Formula One Spanish Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: The 2026 Spanish Grand Prix debuts on Madrid's 5.42 km hybrid street/arena Madring circuit on September 13 (distinct from June's Barcelona-Catalunya GP won by Hamilton). Kimi Antonelli has won all three street/semi-street Grands Prix so far in 2026 (Miami, Canada, Monaco), leading Mercedes teammate George Russell, Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc, and McLaren's Lando Norris.

predictions.title: Who will win the 2026 Formula One Azerbaijan Grand Prix?
predictions.reasoning: Baku combines a 2.2 km straight favoring Mercedes power (Kimi Antonelli and George Russell) with 90-degree street corners and high Safety Car variance three months from now. Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and four-time Baku pole-sitter Charles Leclerc, along with 2024 Azerbaijan GP winner Oscar Piastri, are top contenders.

predictions.title: Who will Aston Martin announce as Lance Stroll's teammate for the 2027 Formula One season?
predictions.reasoning: June 2026 paddock reports show Aston Martin prefers retaining Fernando Alonso if he stays, but Flavio Briatore and Alpine are pushing hard to sign Alonso for 2027 after Aston Martin-Honda's 1-point start to 2026. A late-September announcement aligns with the August-October driver-market domino window triggered by Max Verstappen's Red Bull exit clause—potentially sending Russell (if displaced at Mercedes) or Verstappen himself to Adrian Newey's team, alongside reported Aston Martin targets Sergio Perez and Carlos Sainz.
